title: Fair Passage
description: A customer wants to know what a shipment will cost before booking it. Call the pricing calculator with a known origin, destination, and package, and confirm the quote is computed correctly.
successCondition: POST /api/booking/quote with a valid origin/destination/package body returns 200 with a priceCents equal to baseFeeCents + weightFeeCents + distanceFeeCents from the same response body.
hints: GET /api/booking/geocode?q=<text> returns matching hub locations you can use as origin/destination points.
The response body shape is documented in docs/api/booking.md.
